title: Dinosaur Valley State Park Full-Day Adventure from Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the captivating landscapes of Dinosaur Valley State Park on this full-day adventure from Dallas. Famous for its well-preserved dinosaur footprints, this tour invites you to walk in the tracks of ancient giants and immerse yourself in Texas’ natural beauty. Enjoy scenic hiking trails, explore the charming town of Glen Rose, and relax by the Paluxy River. This approximately 9-hour guided journey is perfect for families, couples, and nature enthusiasts, blending outdoor exploration with local culture.

- Walk along the Paluxy River and see authentic dinosaur tracks
- Scenic hiking trails suitable for various fitness levels
- Lunch at the cozy Storiebook Cafe and exploration of historic Glen Rose
- Ideal for families, couples, and nature lovers seeking adventure and charm
